$Comment: A founder's badge: light the Hollow Lantern with Old Jack during Hallow's Eve 2026, the event's
first year. The calendar_year condition passes only while that year's run is on, so after it
nobody can earn this. It has no Parent and no hallowed tag, so it is one achievement for good
and The Hallowed never waits on it.
To retire it once that season is over, set Enabled false, and in Listing add Feat true and
LegacySince naming the release it stops in. Whoever earned it keeps it among their feats with
that version beside it, and nobody else sees it sitting locked.
